description: Crumbs arrive one after another with their chevrons drawing themselves, a crumb for a deeper page slides in from the right, and links underline from their start.
moves: On first render the crumbs and separators arrive one after another out of a blur.
Going one level deeper, the new crumb slides in from the right at once.
Each separator's chevron draws itself as it arrives.
A link's underline grows from its start on hover or keyboard focus.
In a menu trigger, the ellipsis opens a menu of the pages it stands for.
keyboard: Moves between the links in the trail; the current page is skipped.

propDocs.Breadcrumb.aria-label: Names the navigation landmark. Defaults to "Breadcrumb".
propDocs.BreadcrumbSeparator.children: Your own mark between crumbs, like "/". Defaults to a chevron that draws itself.
propDocs.BreadcrumbEllipsis.children: Your own mark for the pages left out. Defaults to three dots.
